prs.title: Add directional conversation focus shortcuts in workspace mode
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add directional conversation focus shortcuts in workspace mode

## What changed

- Add configurable `focus_pane_left` and `focus_pane_right` actions, defaulting to `leader left` / `leader h` and `leader right` / `leader l`.
- Move focus to the parent or open side conversation without reopening a hidden pane. Preserve the current interaction when no neighbor is available, and accept fresh typing after a no-op shortcut while suppressing reported key repeats.
- Expose the actions in the keymap picker and configuration schema, and prevent workspace-only pane bindings from claiming keys in classic mode.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for pane navigation, preserved transcript selection and search, fresh typing after a no-op, key capture, and binding conflicts and limits.

prs.title: Respect turn filesystem permissions during executor skill discovery
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Respect turn filesystem permissions during executor skill discovery

## Why

Direct executor skill discovery used unrestricted filesystem access, bypassing the turn's permission context. Cached catalogs also needed to account for changes in filesystem access within a turn.

## What changed

- Bind selected capability roots to callback-scoped filesystem access through `AccessedSelectedCapabilityRoot`.
- Pass accessors built with the turn's granted permissions into skill preparation and discovery, removing the executor skill provider's environment lookup and unrestricted accessor.
- Include filesystem access keys in the direct discovery cache so permission changes trigger rediscovery.

## Testing

Extend tests to verify that restricted discovery returns no skills when sandbox access is unavailable, restoring access restores discovery, and changing or restoring access invalidates the catalog cache.

prs.title: Add outcome metrics for skill reads and installation listings
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add outcome metrics for skill reads and installation listings

## What changed

- Record `codex.skills.read.result` and `codex.skills.installations.result` counters with bounded outcome labels for successes and failures.
- Tag both counters with `discovery_version` and installation listings with `source_filter`.
- Make session telemetry available through the step store so skill tools emit metrics with the current step's model metadata.

## Testing

Add coverage for read metrics in both discovery versions, installation listing outcomes and source filters, and extension metrics retaining the current model metadata after a model switch.

prs.title: Switch rusty_v8 to the openai-oss-forks repository
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Switch rusty_v8 to the openai-oss-forks repository

## What changed

Update the `v8` Cargo patch and Bazel archive to use `openai-oss-forks/rusty_v8` with a new pinned revision. Refresh both lockfiles, the archive checksum, and the allowed Git source in `codex-rs/deny.toml`.

prs.title: Route response item IDs through a shared generator
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Route response item IDs through a shared generator

## What changed

Introduce `ItemIdGenerator` and pass the runtime-owned generator through sessions, model clients, history, hooks, tool outputs, and memory requests. Keep UUIDv7 generation as the default and replace direct calls to `ResponseItemId::new` with the shared callable.

Preserve existing item IDs and backfill missing or empty IDs through the same generator, including forked history before reconstruction and persistence.

## Testing

Extend coverage for UUIDv7 IDs on user messages, agent messages, and additional tools, and assert that forked model context matches the backfilled items persisted to history.

prs.title: Restore background terminals from the displayed thread's live state
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Restore background terminals from the displayed thread's live state

## Why

Replaying a fork's inherited command history can make the TUI show background terminals belonging to its parent thread.

## What changed

Fetch the displayed thread's background terminals after history replay instead of treating replayed commands as live terminals. Read all pages, merge without duplicating tracked processes, and exclude terminals that exit while the request is pending. Clear terminal tracking and invalidate pending restoration when resetting thread state or stopping background terminals.

## Testing

Add a regression test verifying that `/ps` shows a resumed fork's own terminal, excludes inherited commands, and does not restore a terminal that exited during the list request.

prs.title: Introduce a dedicated context window ID type
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Introduce a dedicated context window ID type

## What changed

Add `ContextWindowId` as a string-backed protocol type with UUIDv7 generation and parsing. Use it throughout compaction state, rollout reconstruction, token budget context, and request metadata in place of raw UUIDs, preserving the serialized string format and UUIDv7 validation.

prs.title: Stop TUI voice calls when the OS session locks
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Stop TUI voice calls when the OS session locks

## What changed

- Monitor session lock state on Linux, macOS, and Windows, checking the initial state before starting audio.
- Abort local media on lock, including while connecting, retrying, or running a parked call, and display why voice stopped.
- Keep lock monitoring across startup retries and ignore stale lock notifications after a call restarts.
- Document lock behavior and platform limitations. After unlocking, users must run `/voice` to start a new call.

## Testing

Add lifecycle tests for already-locked startup, parked-call media shutdown, stale notifications, and locks during retry cleanup, plus a macOS test for password grace-period expiry.

prs.title: Add cloud thread activation with resolved settings
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add cloud thread activation with resolved settings

## What changed

Add `Client::activate` to load a cloud thread through `UpdateConfig`, sending only the thread ID and `exclude_turns=true`. Return serializable resolved settings, thread metadata, and history cursors while leaving turns for separate pagination. Preserve the original thread protobuf, including unknown fields.

Validate required fields and thread identity, reject unsupported security policies, and redact sensitive activation data in debug output. Treat activation as a mutation that is never retried, with uncertain outcomes reported through `MutationError::OutcomeUnknown`.

## Testing

Add coverage for activation request encoding, settings and metadata preservation, serialization, compatibility defaults, unsupported policies, debug redaction, invalid input rejection, and explicit successful gRPC trailers.

prs.title: Add managed thread prewarming to the cloud client
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add managed thread prewarming to the cloud client

## What changed

Add `Client::prewarm_default_thread` to prepare an ordinary coding thread in the default managed cloud environment, with optional model and provider selection. Return the thread identity and resolved settings as `ThreadActivation` without a separate activation RPC, preserving unknown thread protobuf fields.

Send prewarm requests once without automatic retries or cleanup, and document that a failed response can leave a prepared thread whose identity the caller did not receive.

## Testing

Add coverage for default and explicit model/provider requests, resolved settings and native thread metadata preservation, and rejection of responses missing sandbox policy.

prs.title: Share context window ID allocation through the agent runtime
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Share context window ID allocation through the agent runtime

## What changed

Store a shared `ContextWindowIdGenerator` in `LocalAgentRuntime` and pass it into each session. Use it for both initial context window IDs and subsequent window advances, retaining UUID v7 allocation by default.

Make `AutoCompactWindow` accept caller-provided IDs instead of allocating them directly.

## Testing

Update the window boundary test to verify that advancing installs the supplied ID while preserving the first and previous window IDs.

prs.title: Stabilize cross-platform tests and directory-change fork permissions
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Stabilize cross-platform tests and directory-change fork permissions

## Why

Tests need to distinguish slow subprocess startup from operation timeouts and wait for asynchronous work before asserting results or cleaning up fixtures.

## What changed

- Synchronize subprocess readiness, queued-turn completion, and matching UI events; allow more time for cold startup and separate startup from shutdown deadlines.
- Adapt Windows fixtures and permission expectations, provide the voice-host test runtime DLL path, and normalize platform paths and animated status snapshots.
- Use current configuration permissions when changing directories in embedded TUI sessions, while retaining saved permissions for remote sessions.
- Allow the release prompt-prefix comparison to accept the exact image-tool description update that removes image detail options, and refresh the corresponding tool snapshot.

## Testing

Extend inherited-session metadata coverage to both legacy and paginated thread history, including persisted history mode and revision-aware resume.

prs.title: Honor section limits in elastic Guardian context budgeting
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Honor section limits in elastic Guardian context budgeting

## Why

Elastic allocation could shrink section minimums under budget pressure and bypass section maxima when the complete request fit. Instruction deduplication also needs to account for which transcript entries actually survive allocation.

## What changed

- Fund demand-capped section minimums before scaling headroom up to section maxima. Reject requests whose minimum reservations cannot fit after duplicate credit.
- Prioritize required records over optional records within each section, reconsider selections when redistributing packing gaps, and reserve global space for protected content and framing.
- Deduplicate retained instructions only against complete selected transcript sources, keep that proof selected during refills, and reuse the released budget.
- Retain elastic transcript history by byte limits instead of fixed item counts. On non-user byte overflow, evict whole older entries toward half the byte allowance.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for section minimums and maxima, priority selection, shared framing, duplicate-proof refills, and elastic history retention and replay.

prs.title: Fix missing item ID generators in retained instruction tests
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix missing item ID generators in retained instruction tests

Pass `uuid_v7_item_id_generator_for_test()` to the two remaining
`record_user_message` calls in the transcript source-proof and budgeting test
to match the required API signature.

prs.title: Preserve pending agent messages across compaction
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve pending agent messages across compaction

## Why

Agent messages that arrive after a model request starts must survive compaction until a normal inference request includes them. Compactor output alone does not establish that those messages were delivered.

## What changed

- Persist history sequences and sampling checkpoints in harness metadata, capturing the input prefix for each normal inference request.
- Retain pending agent messages within existing size budgets during local and remote compaction, placing the summary before pending messages and subsequent caller input.
- Preserve sampling progress across history replacement and resume, and drain queued mail after interrupted sampling even when compaction leaves context above the token limit.

## Testing

Add regression coverage for request-boundary sampling checkpoints, pending messages across local compaction and repeated remote compaction with resume, and injected messages that interrupt sampling before mid-turn compaction.

prs.title: Add opt-in elastic budgeting for synchronous Guardian reviews
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Add opt-in elastic budgeting for synchronous Guardian reviews

## What changed

- Add `features.guardianv2.sync_elastic_budgeting` and `sync_elastic_sections` to configure section minimums, per-entry token caps, and optional section maximums. Require and validate section limits when enabled.
- Use the selected budgeting policy consistently for history capture, resume, prompt preparation, and review input budgeting. Keep fixed budgeting as the default.

## Testing

Add configuration validation tests, capture-and-resume coverage for both budgeting modes, and a request-history snapshot verifying retained instructions and transcript section limits.

prs.title: Warn when project instructions exceed the configured byte budget
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Warn when project instructions exceed the configured byte budget

## Why

Project instructions could be truncated or skipped when the byte budget ran out without a user-facing warning.

## What changed

- Report truncated files and skipped files or environments, with guidance to trim instructions or increase `project_doc_max_bytes`.
- Warn when combined instructions exceed the configured budget, clarifying that global and thread instructions contribute to the total but the limit applies only to project files.
- Refresh cached project instructions when `project_doc_max_bytes` changes.

## Testing

Add warning snapshots for truncated files, skipped files and environments, and combined instructions exceeding the budget.

prs.title: Restore the daemon auto-start feature flag
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Restore the daemon auto-start feature flag

## What changed

Honor `features.daemon_auto_start` as a stable, default-enabled setting instead of ignoring it with a deprecation warning. Apply it to interactive daemon auto-start and remote-control daemon eligibility, and accept it in managed feature requirements.

Preserve explicit `false` values when saving the setting, even when the server reports a disabled default. Record the setting and disabled auto-start outcomes in launch telemetry.

## Testing

Update coverage for restarting a discovered daemon with auto-start disabled and for persisting an explicit opt-out when the server default is disabled. Adjust embedded-backend tests to disable auto-start through configuration.

prs.title: Prefer Launchpad for Linux zlib downloads in `rules_rs`
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Prefer Launchpad for Linux zlib downloads in `rules_rs`

## What changed

Update the `rules_rs` patch to try Launchpad first for the Linux `aarch64`
and `x86_64` zlib packages, retaining the dated Ubuntu snapshot URLs as
fallbacks. Keep the pinned package versions and SHA-256 hashes unchanged.

prs.title: Carry per-input extension data to user message completion callbacks
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Carry per-input extension data to user message completion callbacks

## What changed

Add `user_input_extension_data` to `TurnInputRequest` and carry it with each queued user input through completion, including inputs that steer an active turn. Expose the data to lifecycle contributors through `on_item_completed_with_metadata`, whose default implementation forwards to `on_item_completed` for compatibility. Keep this data out of model input and preserve the existing serialized input shape when no extension data is present.

## Testing

Add serialization round-trip coverage and extend the concurrent submission test to verify that inputs sharing a client ID retain their own metadata, report completion in the accepting turn, and omit extension data from model requests.

prs.title: Drain queued side-conversation events before switching focus
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Drain queued side-conversation events before switching focus

## Why

Pressing `Ctrl-/` immediately after `/btw` must not switch focus before the queued side-conversation prompt is dispatched.

## What changed

Wait for queued app events to drain before reading terminal input when the displayed thread belongs to a parent/side conversation pair, even when side retention is disabled. This keeps queued prompts and transcript updates ahead of focus changes.

## Testing

Extend the side-conversation startup test to toggle focus at the earliest allowed opportunity and verify that the turn starts on the side thread. Also check that a queued request to reopen the side conversation blocks terminal input until handled.

prs.title: Allow prepared forks to use source revalidation
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Allow prepared forks to use source revalidation

## What changed

Add `PreparedFork::with_source_revalidation` for backends that revalidate the source when making the child's history reference durable, allowing the source reservation to be omitted.

Rename the reservation-backed constructor to `with_source_reservation` and update the local thread store to use it, preserving its source deletion protection.

prs.title: Preserve transcript interaction when switching panes with arrow keys
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve transcript interaction when switching panes with arrow keys

## Why

Directional pane switching cleared the parent conversation's transcript selection or Find state, so returning to it interrupted the interaction.

## What changed

Route left/right pane switches through the existing conversation toggle to park and restore each pane's transcript interaction. Explicitly focusing the main composer still clears transcript interaction.

## Testing

Extend the side-conversation test to cover restoring selections, Find text and caret position, and composer input after scrolling. Add a snapshot verifying that Find remains editable after switching away and back.

prs.title: Extract agent message board hosting into a dedicated crate
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Extract agent message board hosting into a dedicated crate

## Why

Core tests depend on `codex-app-server` to install and clean up agent message boards. A dedicated host crate lets them use this functionality without depending on the app server.

## What changed

Move the existing host implementation into `codex-agent-message-board-host` and update core test helpers and scenarios to use it directly. Keep the installation and deletion functions re-exported from `codex-app-server`.

Add configuration-loader coverage for explicit user and project settings, including a project setting overridden by a session flag, and for session-only overrides. Update the default-enabled feature check to allow deprecated features.

prs.title: Preserve project agent opt-ins across enabled legacy feature flags
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Preserve project agent opt-ins across enabled legacy feature flags

## Why

An enabled legacy feature flag could prevent a project's `agents.enabled = true` from overriding a lower-priority legacy opt-out, leaving V1 agent tools unavailable.

## What changed

Only stop scanning configuration layers at an explicit legacy feature opt-out. Enabled flags now allow the scan to continue, so project opt-ins can override lower-priority opt-outs while same-layer and higher-priority opt-outs remain effective.

## Testing

Extend the model runtime selector regression test to cover enabled `features.collab` flags in project configuration and CLI overrides, and verify that explicit `false` values still disable V1 agent tools.

Fix reasoning summary restoration in the TUI
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix reasoning summary restoration in the TUI

## Why

Reasoning summaries can arrive with item start or completion events rather than streamed deltas. The TUI can miss or truncate these summaries, and replay after a voice handoff can hide reasoning that started before the handoff.

## What changed

- Initialize reasoning from item start payloads and reconcile live and replayed completions with their full summaries. Preserve streamed text when completion payloads are empty, and continue honoring `show_raw_agent_reasoning`.
- Retain active reasoning payloads across refreshes without resetting an already active item when its start event is replayed.
- Preserve the typed origin of reasoning started before a voice handoff and filter later delegated reasoning starts from buffered replay.

## Testing

Extend regression coverage for summaries supplied at start or completion, partial streamed summaries, active reasoning after refresh, and replay that retains pre-handoff summaries while hiding delegated reasoning even after the handoff marker is evicted.

prs.title: Fix TUI assistant messages interrupted by tool execution
prs.author: copyberry[bot]
prs.body:
Fix TUI assistant messages interrupted by tool execution

## Why

A tool can start before an assistant message finishes streaming. The TUI needs to incorporate the completed text without duplicating the reply or leaving Markdown split across interrupted fragments. Some streams also include initial text in `item/started` before sending deltas.

## What changed

- Display initial assistant text from `item/started`, avoiding duplicate starts for the same message.
- Track interrupted replies by turn and item ID, then replace their flushed fragments with the completed message at the reply's original position, preserving intervening tool order.
- Re-render the completed Markdown and update transcript views and scrollback.

## Testing

Extend streaming tests to cover initial text, resumed deltas, Markdown spanning a tool interruption, and matching live and replayed transcripts. Expand completion-repair cases to cover missing text and resumed fragments.
